omega.contract: Structured provider call, native tool dispatch and history
An empty native call list becomes explicit feedback; a later ordered batch executes
Unknown native tool and malformed MeTTa call become explicit per-call feedback
Current upstream provider containment turns a provider exception into empty-call feedback
Repeated nonempty input updates previous-message state without rearming
Later iterations decrement loops before receiving input
Strict nextWakeAt comparison and maxWakeLoops-plus-one rearming
Native call IDs and ordered results stay paired, including MeTTa evaluation as an ordinary tool
History persistence and maxHistory/maxFeedback tail selection
Duplicate send suppression and newline transport escaping
Dynamic skills, prompt extensions and heartbeat listener behavior
History survives; initLoop resets previous message, last results and loop budget
